## How to Use the Colormag Header Builder

<https://docs.themegrill.com/colormag/docs/header-builder-2/>

The ColorMag Header Builder lets you create a fully customized header for your ColorMag WordPress theme using a drag-and-drop interface. You can add, remove, and rearrange header elements such as your logo, navigation menus, search icon, social icons, buttons, and widgets, all without writing any code.

### Step 1: Open the Header Builder

Go to **Appearance → Customize → Header** in your WordPress dashboard.

The Header Builder is built into the ColorMag WordPress theme, so the visual builder interface loads directly in the Customizer without any setup step.

### Step 2: Understand the Header Layout

The Header Builder divides your header into three rows:

Row Typically used for
**Top Row** Secondary menus, contact details, social icons, announcements
**Main Row** Site logo, primary navigation menu, search icon
**Bottom Row** Additional menus, widgets, custom content

- **Top Row** – ideal for secondary menus, contact information, social icons, or announcements

- **Main Row** – typically holds your site logo, primary navigation menu, and search icon

- **Bottom Row** – useful for additional menus, widgets, or custom content

**Each row has a drag-and-drop area where you can place header elements in your preferred layout.**

You can add the following elements to any row:

- **Site Logo**

- **Site Title & Tagline**

- **Primary Menu**

- **Secondary Menu**

- **Search**

- **Button**

- **Social Icons**

- **Date**

- **Random Post**

- **News Ticker**

- **Widgets**

- **Custom HTMLNote:** Some elements are only available in ColorMag Pro. If an element isn’t showing up for you, check whether it’s Pro-only before assuming something is broken.

### Step 3: Add and Arrange Elements

- In the Header Builder, drag an element from the available list into the Top Row, Main Row, or Bottom Row.

- Click on the element once it’s added to open its individual settings — this is where you can typically adjust things like alignment, visibility (desktop/mobile), spacing, and color, depending on the element.

- Repeat for each element you want to include in your header.

To reorder elements, drag them to a new position — either within the same row or into a different row. The live preview updates instantly, so you can see exactly how your header will look before you publish anything.

### Step 4: Preview Your Header on Different Devices

Your header can look different on desktop, tablet, and mobile, so it’s worth checking all three before publishing

- Use the responsive preview controls at the bottom of the Customizer to switch between **Desktop**, **Tablet**, and **Mobile** views.

- Review your layout on each view and adjust element settings if anything looks cramped or out of place — for example, some elements can be hidden on mobile if they take up too much space.

### Step 5: Publish Your Changes

Once you’re happy with your header layout and settings, click **Publish**.

Changes you make in the Customizer are only visible to you in the live preview — visitors won’t see the new header on your live site until you click Publish.

## Manage BreadCrumb

<https://docs.themegrill.com/colormag/docs/manage-breadcrumb/>

**Location**: Appearance → Customize → Header & Navigation → Breadcrumb

Breadcrumb helps users to visualize the location of the site. It’s a secondary navigation bar that typically appears as a horizontal text link, separated by an angle bracket.

ColorMag themes offer displaying the Breadcrumb on the site and come with the following options:

## Enable

Switch the Toggle to the right area to enable the** Breadcrumb** on your site. Enabling the option will display the breadcrumbs below the header main area.

Enable Breadcrumb

## Type **Pro**

With the ColorMag theme, you can add the Breadcrumb provided by the theme or third-party plugins. **[Available in ColorMag Pro]**

### None

You can choose the none option if you do not want to display the Breadcrumb on your end.

### Yoast SEO/NavXT

ColorMag supports two plugins for achieving the Breadcrumb feature on your site. You can use any of them according to your convenience.

To add Breadcrumb in ColorMag, you must install and activate either Yoast SEO or Breadcrumb NavXT plugin per your preference.

You can choose the one from the dropdown option under the type section. The options are listed below:

**Yoast SEO**

You can follow the steps below to activate the Yoast SEO Breadcrumb on your site.

- Go to your **Dashboard** → **Yoast Seo** →** Search Appearance**.

- Under the **Search Appearance** section, look for the **Breadcrumb** tab.

- Enable the option and save the changes.

Breadcrumb NavXT–

You can follow the steps below to activate the Breadcrumb NavXT on your site.

- Go to your **Dashboard** → **Settings** →** Breadcrumb NavXT**.

- Inside the **Breadcrumb NavXT** settings, make the necessary changes per the site requirement.

- Save the Changes.

Once the plugin settings have been configured from your end, you can enable the Breadcrumb from the customizer. Once you select the Yoast Seo/NavXT, the Breadcrumb will automatically appear on your site

Once the plugin settings have been configured from your end, you can enable the Breadcrumb from the customizer. Once you select the Yoast Seo/NavXT, the Breadcrumb will automatically appear above the content area of each page.

### ColorMag Theme **Pro**

ColorMag theme comes with the default theme Breadcrumb which does not require third-party plugins. You can choose the option **ColorMag Theme **under the type, which will display the Breadcrumb displays on each page of your site. **[Available in ColorMag Pro]**

Breadcrumb From ColorMag Theme

## Label

ColorMag theme allows you to change the Breadcrumb label of your choice. By default, the breadcrumb Label is **You are here:** which can be changed.

Change Breadcrumb Label Text

## Customize Sticky Header

<https://docs.themegrill.com/colormag/docs/customize-sticky-header/>

**Location:** Appearance → Customize → Header & Navigation → Sticky Header

A **Sticky Header** refers to a design where the Header is fixed in its position while scrolling the site below. It helps the user access the header information without scrolling back to the top of the page.

## Enable

Switch the Toggle to the right area to enable the **Sticky Header** on your site. Enabling the option will allow the Header to be sticky.

Enable Sticky Header

## Effect **Pro**

After enabling the Sticky Header, it will allow you to change the way the sticky Header works. It comes with the following two options: **[Available in ColorMag Pro]**

### Default

In the Default mode, the Header is sticky while scrolling the site down and up.

Default Sticky Header Style

### Scroll Up

In the Scroll Up mode, the Header is sticky while scrolling the site from down to up. While scrolling the site down, the sticky header disappears.

Scroll Up Sticky Header Style

## Customize the Primary Menu of the Site

<https://docs.themegrill.com/colormag/docs/customize-the-primary-menu-of-the-site/>

**Location:** Appearance → Customize → Header & Navigation → Primary Menu

The Primary/Navigation menu in the ColorMag theme lies on the Primary Header area. Generally, a primary menu includes links to the most essential pages of your site. The theme allows customizing the primary menu with various options listed below:

## General

### Category Color **Pro**

Basically, in the primary menu of the ColorMag theme, we add categories as primary menu items. This section changes the categories menu background color while hovering over them. The color is taken from the category color added from the section here.

Enable Category Color

## Style

### Background

It sets the background color for the primary menu area. You can add a Background **Color **or an** Image** to the primary menu.

Change Primary Menu Background

### Border Top

It changes the **Border Color** that appears at the top of the menu items.

Change Border Top Color

### Padding **Pro**

It adjusts the padding spaces of the primary menu items in the Left, Right, Top, and Bottom areas.

Change Primary Menu Padding Area

## Main Menu

ColorMag allows you to customize the primary menu items with the following option listed below:

- **Color **– It changes the menu item color for normal and hover/selected state.

Change Primary Menu Item Color

- **Typography **– It controls the primary menu item’s Font Family, Weight, and Font Size.

Change Primary Menu Item Typography

## Sub Menu

ColorMag allows you to customize the sub-menu items with the following option listed below:

Main Header with Center Alignment

Main Header with Full Width Layout

- **Contained **– It displays the Main Header area width with respect to the container area.

Main Header with Contained Layout

ColorMag theme option to set the background for the primary header section. You can add the **Color** or **Image** to customize the primary header background.

Change Main Header Background Color

- After creating the new menu, go to the “Menu Locations” and choose the Top Bar Menu option.

## Customize the Date in Top Bar

<https://docs.themegrill.com/colormag/docs/customize-the-date-in-top-bar/>

**Location**: Appearance → Customize → Header & Navigation→ Top Bar → Date

ColorMag theme supports adding the **Date** in the top bar. It comes with the following option to customize the date in the top bar area:

## Enable

Switch the Toggle to the right area to enable the Date in the top bar. Enabling the option will display the Date on the top bar area.

Enable Date

## Date Format

It determines the way the date gets displayed on your end. It provides the option to choose how the date should appear and comes with the following options:

## Customize the Site Logo, Site Icon, Site Title, and Tagline

<https://docs.themegrill.com/colormag/docs/customize-the-site-logo-site-icon-site-title-and-tagline/>

**Location: **Appearance → Customize → Header & Navigation → Site Identity

The **Site Identity** option allows you to customize the site’s** Site Logo, Title, Tagline, etc. **These are visible on all pages and posts. Moreover, it helps the users be aware of the website and brand they interact with.

Under the Site Identity, you get the following options listed from where you can add the Logo, Title, and other necessary elements.

## Site Logo

ColorMag allows adding both the Normal and Retina Logo. For the normal logo, select a logo image from the Media Library and upload it to your site.

**Retina Logo **– Retina Logo refers to the high-definition logo designed to display well in high-resolution devices, i.e., Apple devices. While uploading the Retina Logo, make sure to upload 2X times the size of the normal logo to prevent the logo look blurry on retina devices.

## Height **Pro**

You can set the **Height **of the logo with the slider available. This will set the Height of the logo and doesn’t change the width.

Change Site Logo and Height

## Site Icon

The Site Icon is a small unique icon that appears in the tab of the browser’s tab bookmarks bars. From the option available within the theme, you can upload the site icon. The recommended size for a favicon is **512 pixels**.

## Site Title

The Site Title is usually the name of the website or business that appears in the header area at the top of the site. It helps visitors quickly identify what the website is about. ColorMag provides the option to add the Site Title and comes with the following options:

- **Site Title** – Add the appropriate **Site Title** that best suits your web/business site.

- **Enable** – Toggle the option to the right side, displaying the site title in the header area.

- **Color** – Choose the appropriate Text **Color** for the site title.

- **Typography** – It controls the site title typography option, such as **Font Family** and **Font Size**.

Site Title Customization

## Site Tagline

The **Site Tagline** is a short statement that describes the site title and provides a brief description of the website. It is usually displayed near the site title on the website’s header area. ColorMag provides the option to add the **Site Tagline** and comes with the following options:

- **Site Title** – Add the appropriate **Site Tagline** that best suits your web/business site.

- **Enable** – Toggle the option to the right side, which will display the site tagline in the header area.

- **Colors** – Choose the appropriate Text **Color** for the site tagline.

- **Typography **– It controls the site tagline typography option, such as **Font Family** and **Font Size**.

Site Tagline Customization

## Customize News Ticker in Top Bar

<https://docs.themegrill.com/colormag/docs/customize-news-ticker-in-top-bar/>

**Location:** Appearance → Customize → Header → News Ticker

ColorMag supports showing the News Ticker in the Header area. It helps users continuously stream breaking news without constantly refreshing the website. ColorMag allows different ways of customizing the News Ticker with the option listed below:

## General

It comes with the following options for customizing the News Ticker:

### Enable

Under Breaking News, toggle the option over the right area to **Enable **the Breaking News section in the Header area.

Enable Breaking News on Top Bar

### Position **Pro**

By default, the News Ticker appears at the Header Top Bar. However, ColorMag allows you to display Breaking News in two different areas of the site. The options are listed below:

- **Top Bar** – It displays the News Ticker section in the Top Bar.

News Ticker Position in Top Bar

- **Below Navigation** – It displays the News Ticker section below the Primary Menu.

News Ticker Position in Below Header

### Filter **Pro**

The filter option allows you to choose which type of news to appear in the News Ticker section.

- **Latest Posts**: It allows you to show your site’s newest/latest posts.

News Ticker Displaying Post Based on Latest Posts

- **Category**: It allows showing the posts from a specific category only.

News Ticker Displaying Post Based on Category

### Label **Pro**

The option allows you to change the default News Ticker title. The default title is the** Latest, **which can be changed to your requirement.

Change News Ticket Label Text

## Style **Pro**

It comes with the following options for styling the News Ticker:

### Typography

The Typography option controls the News Ticker section’s Font Family, Weight, and Font Size. It comes with the following two options:

- **Label Typography**: It allows you to set the typography option for the news ticker **Label** area.

Change Label Typography

- **Content Typography**: It allows you to set the typography option for the news ticker **Content **area.

Change Content Typography

### Animation

It helps you customize how the news ticker appears, including the style, duration, and speed.

- **Animation Style**: It sets the style while the news switches from one to another news, i.e., **Up** or **Down**.

- **Animation Duration**: It sets the duration of the time the news gets displayed on the news ticker area.

- **Transition Speed**: It sets the duration of the time the news switches from one to another news.

## Customize Top Bar

<https://docs.themegrill.com/colormag/docs/customize-top-bar/>

**Location:** Appearance → Customize → Header & Navigation → Top Bar

The **Top Ba**r is an essential area of your site where you can showcase important information such as Date, Breaking News, Menus, etc. ColorMag theme allows you to enable the Top Bar and add that information. It comes with the following options:

## General

**Enable **– It allows you to enable or disable the Top Bar per your site requirement.

Enable Top bar

**Full Width **– It allows displaying the Top Bar content to the entire screen width. **[Available in ColorMag Pro ]**

- **Border Bottom Size** – ColorMag theme supports displaying the border at the Bottom of the Top Bar area. This helps site visitors visualize where the top bar ends and the header area gets started. You can choose the **Thickness** of the bottom border size of the top bar.

Change Border Bottom Size

- **Border Bottom Colo**r: Choose the **Color** for the bottom border of the top.

Change Border Bottom Color
